prompt:
A full-body character image, vertical 2:3 (1024×1536): Zhou Tai of the Romance of the Three Kingdoms, reimagined as an adult woman — the guardian whose body became covered with scars saving Sun Quan.

1. STYLE
Korean MMORPG character artwork. A recognisably drawn face with gently simplified anatomical structure. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
Her face is small and soft: a short midface, a softly rounded jaw and a small chin, about 1.3 times as long as it is wide, with her eyes open at their natural size. Bangs, side locks and headpieces frame the face without lengthening it.
Skin finish: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

2. CHARACTER
Age: mid-twenties — a clear adult face.
Face — her own, recognisably this character, a woman's face with no beard or facial hair: a rugged, tough, outdoorsy look; light warm-beige skin with a golden undertone; round face; smaller, narrower eyes than usual anime proportion — peach-blossom eyes with a soft, curved lower lid, outer eye corners drooping downward; soft rounded brows; straight narrow nose; full wide lips; ember-orange eyes; a thin faint scar through one eyebrow.
Body and hair: strong and broad-shouldered with firm muscle, yet full-busted with wide rounded hips and a defined waist build; very long hair streaming sideways in the wind with short baby bangs; hot-pink hair.
Expression: a level, steady look, mouth closed, subtle and relaxed.
Legend, carried in her design and bearing: countless scars each with a story, unwavering loyalty, heavy armor.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME AND EQUIPMENT — MECHA
Costume: a female mecha personification built as an assault-type mecha frame — heavy armor plates, thruster packs, reinforced limbs, her weapon rebuilt as a large mecha armament. Solid hard-surface plates with visible joints cover her frame except at the openings named under Exposure; any cape or skirt is made of rigid armored plates; her face and hair stay human.
Silhouette: several long rigid jointed plates hanging from behind the shoulders to the ankles like a cape — plates, not cloth. This silhouette sets the overall shape of the costume above — keep its materials, ornaments and rank in this shape; the details are free.
Colours: crimson red, gold, river teal, black lacquer. Faction frame: crimson and black lacquer plating with gold edges, streamlined naval hull shapes and fin binders, hydrojet thrusters, flame-orange glow lines.
Signature item: a broad saber, rebuilt as a far-future high-tech version of the same kind of object with the same silhouette — hard-surface alloy plates with panel lines, mechanical joints, vents and emitter nodes, an energy edge, plasma blade or glowing core in her glow-line colour and small status lights, with any animal motif re-sculpted as sleek machined armour. She holds it at full scale: one whole object, drawn once, held in front of or beside her body; a long weapon keeps one straight, unbroken shaft with a single head or blade.
Exposure (bold): her mecha frame is cut open by design in only these places — a deep open chest window with natural cleavage framed by the chest plates, and a bare waist and midriff between the bust plate and the hip armor; everywhere else she stays fully plated. The plates stay on, fitted and symmetrical, with skin clearly showing in each opening. Intimate areas covered; keep the plate material and palette.

4. SCENE
World: year 2190, the Wu carrier fleet in orbit above an ocean world: crimson starships and carriers, a glowing nebula, the planet's blue oceans and storm clouds below, neon running lights on the hulls.
TIME & WEATHER: night — the scene lit by its own fires, lamps or glow, a dark sky above.
Pose: Leaning back against a structure of the world (gate, pillar, rail, banner pole), arms relaxed.
Light: a soft key light with a strong rim light tracing her hair, shoulders and armour; bright, crisp specular highlights on metal and jewellery, and a clean, warm-neutral sheen on her skin.
Composition: her whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet inside the frame with clear margins, about four-fifths of the image height; camera at chest height with natural portrait perspective.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only — no second character, horse or other creature. No readable text or numbers — emblems are abstract insignia shapes only, never letters or Chinese characters. No logo, watermark, speech bubble or frame border. A far-future setting only — space stations, starships and high-tech structures — with no traditional East-Asian architecture.
Avoid: a blue or bruise-like tint on the skin around the eyes, glossy or shiny highlights on the face, sweaty, oily or plastic-looking skin.

observations: 궤도 시설 난간과 판형 메카 갑주, 발광 대도와 핫핑크색 긴 머리가 보인다.
왼손이 손잡이를 쥐고 오른손은 구조물 위로 내려뜨렸다.
